735140101.text: That was close... Even the Wenut have come to mess up our plan...

735140102.text: Hey! If we hadn't deactivated the ignition, we could have killed it!

735140103.text: Now that the Wenut has escaped, it'll be at least one more day before it lets its guard down again.

735140104.text: You're not planning to argue over the tiniest detail and let it go again tomorrow, are you?

735140105.text: Um, but what about the parameters...

735140106.text: I have tested them all, and although the charging speed is a little lower than the calculated value, it does not affect use, and there are no safety risks.

735140107.text: Shriya, I know you want to consider and analyze everything before acting, but you know, things don't always go according to plan.

735140108.text: If you keep getting hung up over the small details, you'll miss the best opportunity to act! Remember that time our mid-term thesis defense got delayed? Hesitating won't get us anywhere.

735140110.text: Alright! Tomorrow, we'll finally be able to put the Wenutslayer Cannon into action!

735140111.text: I'd like to bring them back to Aaru Village and tinker around with them a little more. We gotta make sure we're properly ready for the Wenutslayer Cannon's first ever official appearance!

735140112.text: ...But why is there a deviation in the environmental parameters? What caused the Wenut to suddenly act out?

735140113.text: #You really can't just let these matters rest... {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer, could you please come back tomorrow?

735140114.text: By then, we should be facing the Wenut directly, and hopefully we'll have some sort of clue.
